chunks: Do not give false testimony, and do not sit at a table at which alcohol is served, for the servant does not know when he will be taken (die).

When one of you sits to eat, let him sit like a servant, and let not one of you place one leg over the other, nor sit in the 'turban' posture (cross-legged with knees wide), for it is a posture God dislikes and despises its companion. The meal of the Prophets was after dusk.

Do not forgo the evening meal, for leaving it ruins the body. Fever is the forerunner of death and God's prison on earth, in which He confines whom He wills of His servants, and it is under the sins as the wool sheds from the hump of the camel.

There is no illness except that it is from inside the belly, except for wounds and fever, for they return to the body (from outside). Break the heat of fever with violet and cold water, for its heat is from the exhalation of Hell.
A Muslim does not get treated until his illness overcomes his health. Supplication repels the decreed destiny, so take it as equipment.

For ablution after purification, there are ten good deeds. Purify yourselves from the bad smell of the wind (burp/breath) that causes annoyance. Attend to your selves, for God the Exalted dislikes the filthy one among His servants, from whom those who sit with him are disgusted.

Let not a man play with his beard or with what distracts him from his prayer while praying. Hasten to do good before you are occupied with other things. The believer is in toil for himself, while people are at ease because of him.
Let most of your speech be the remembrance of God the Exalted. Guard against sins, for the servant sins and his sustenance is withheld. Cure your sick with charity. Protect your wealth with zakat.

Prayer is the offering of every pious person. Hajj is the jihad of every weak person. The jihad of a woman is good husbandry (taking care of her husband). Poverty is the greatest death. Few dependents is one of the two forms of wealth. Destiny is half of life. Sorrow is half of old age.

No matter becomes difficult except if one moderates, and no matter goes wrong except if one seeks advice. Kindness is not effective except with one of noble lineage or religion. Everything has a fruit, and the fruit of good deeds is hastening them. Whoever is certain of the return will be generous with his gift.

He who strikes his hands on his thighs in times of calamity loses his reward. The best of a man's deeds is waiting for relief from God the Exalted. He who saddens his parents has disobeyed them. Bring down sustenance with charity.

Repel the waves of calamity from you with supplication before the calamity arrives. By Him who split the grain and created the soul, calamity rushes to the believer faster than a flood descending from the top of a hill to its bottom, and faster than the running of camels. Ask God for protection from the hardship of calamity, for the hardship of calamity is the loss of religion.

key_terms.حُسْنُ التَّبَعُلِ: Good husbandry/excellence in being a wife
key_terms.يَتَرَبَّعْ: Sitting posture with knees wide (turban style)

ai.seo_question: What are the key ethical and spiritual teachings of Imam Ali regarding daily conduct, health, and worship?
ai.summary: Compiled by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Al-Khisal*, this narration exemplifies the Shia tradition of *adab al-dunya wa al-din* (etiquette of life and religion), blending physical hygiene with spiritual mindfulness. It highlights the metaphysical impact of daily habits, such as linking modest eating postures to divine pleasure and framing supplication as a dynamic force that can alter *al-qada al-mubram* (decree). The text underscores the holistic Islamic view where physical ailments like fever are treated both medically and spiritually, reflecting the integration of body and soul in Shia piety.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 27-6 Do not give false testimony.Do not sit at a table at which alcohol is served since you never know when you will die.

When you go to the table to eat, sit like a good servant of God. Do not sit with your legs crossed, since God doesn’t like this kind of sitting and considers those who sit that way to be His enemy.The Prophets dined after dusk.

Do not forgo eating dinner since that would ruin the body.Fever is the forerunner for death. It is God’s prison on the Earth. Whenever God wants to imprison someone on the Earth, he would get a fever. Fever would shed one’s sins as leaves fall off a tree in the fall.
All illnesses are internal except for wounds and fever that enter the body.Lessen the burning of fever with violet and cool water, since such a burning is from hell.
Do not treat a Muslim until illness overtakes him.Saying supplications would change destiny. Use it as a tool for defense.

There are ten good aspects of making ablutions after cleaning one’s self.Do not be lazy since a lazy person would not honor the Honorable the Exalted God’s rights.You should renew your ablutions when you let out bad-smelling air.Cleanse yourself since the Honorable the Exalted God doesn’t like a filthy person and anyone who sits with him would hate him.

You should not play with your beard while you are saying your prayers. You should not play with anything else either while you are praying.Strive to do good deeds before you get busy with other work.A believer is one who suffers himself while others are comfortable with him.

The best of your sayings are the remembrance of the Honorable the Exalted God.Do not commit sins since that would imprison your share of daily bread.Treat the patients in your family by giving charity, and guard your property by paying the alms-tax.

Prayer is the tool for becoming near to God for all pious people.Hajj is the weak people’s holy war.The Holy War for a women is taking good care of her husband.Poverty is the greatest death.Having a small family is a type of wealth.Destiny is half of life.Sadness is half of oldness.

No one who is moderate will ever become poor.Whoever seeks advice regarding his affairs would not get harmed.Kindness is good to noble or religious men.There is a fruit for everything. The fruit of good deeds lies in hurrying up in doing them.Anybody who is certain that God will give in return would give charity.

The reward of one who doesn’t do anything in times of difficulty will be ruined.The best deed for man is waiting for the arrival of the Relief (i.e. the Riser (MGB)) from the Honorable the Exalted God.He who makes his mother and father sad has becomes disobedient of them.Expedite the arrival of your sustenance by giving charity.

Fend off calamities by saying supplications before the calamities arrive.I swear by Him who splits up a seed and creates man, the speed with which poverty and calamities rush towards a believer is more than the downward speed of the flood from the top of the mountain and the running speed of camels.Ask God for protection against calamities since hard disasters can take away one’s religion.
